pub fn terminal_qm31(
            self,
            claims: &[[QM31; 29]; 3],
            alpha: &[QM31; 10],
            c: &Challenges,
        ) -> Result<QM31, Error> {
            let selected = core::array::from_fn(|i| claims[i / 28][i % 28]);
            terminal_parts(
                self.semantic(),
                &selected,
                alpha,
                c.lambda,
                c.chi,
                c.theta,
                &c.zc,
                c.mu,
            )
            .map(|parts| parts.0)
            .map_err(|_| Error::Public)
        }
